title: Work in the cloud
intro: Pick what you want to do with a cloud session.

inputs.label: Goal
options: Start a task from the browser
Start a task from the terminal

when.equals: Start a task from the browser

show.title: claude.ai/code
show.detail: Connect GitHub, pick a repository and an environment, and describe the task. It keeps running if you close the tab.

trace.text: Open claude.ai/code and choose a repository.
Runs the task on a cloud machine.

when.equals: Start a task from the terminal

show.title: claude --cloud
show.detail: The task starts in a new cloud session, so your terminal is free.

trace.text: Creates a cloud session for the task.

show.title: Teleport
show.detail: Bring the session, with its history and branch, into your terminal.

trace.text: Lists your cloud sessions and opens the one you pick.

show.title: Not available
show.detail: Cloud sessions need a Claude plan; they aren't offered through third-party cloud providers.

trace.text: Cloud sessions are not available with this provider.

quiz.question: You start a cloud session and close your laptop. What happens?
options: It keeps running in the cloud
quiz.explanation: Cloud sessions run on a managed machine, so they carry on while your computer is off.
